To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the FVF LDO regulator with DSMFC technique is capable of driving the widest range of output capacitor with respect to other reported works.
the proposed LDOC regulator can be stabilized over the widest CL range and achieve the highest FOM with respect to the other works.
the proposed OCL-LDO regulator is capable of driving a wide range of load capacitance and has a high CL(max)/CC value.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and implementation of a low power, low dropout regulator for portable devices.
the development of an OCL-LDO regulator that can drive the widest CL range.
the stability of LDO regulators with DSMFC technique.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed L DO regulator is a good candidate for wide load capacitance range applications.
the proposed OCL-LDO regulator can provide the widest CL range and the highest CL(max) /CC ratio among the counterparts.
the proposed LDOC can achieve the best performance in terms of CL(max)/CC and FOM.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed L DO regulator can be a potential candidate for the next generation portable electronic devices.
it is the first FVF based LDO regulator that can support a CL range of 6 decades and achieve the highest CC reduction ratio.
the proposed LDOC can achieve the widest load capacitance range with the highest CC/CL(max) ratio, which is the most important figure for OCL-LDOs.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed DSMFC technique can be utilized to design a wide load capacitance range OCL-LDO regulator.
the proposed LVO-based DSMFC can effectively stabilize the OCL-LDO regulator with a wide range of CC and CL, and thus, it is suitable for a variety of portable and mobile applications.
the proposed LDOC regulator can be used in a wide range of applications with different load capacitances.
